response.sql:
WITH large_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    amount,
    balance,
    type
  FROM trans
  WHERE amount >= 2400
),
account_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN CAST(amount AS REAL)
      WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -CAST(amount AS REAL)
    END) as avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(CAST(balance AS REAL)) as avg_balance,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as signed_count
  FROM large_trans
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN signed_count > 0 THEN avg_signed_amount END) as avg_signed_amount,
  AVG(avg_balance) as avg_balance
FROM account_stats

assumptions.assumption: The second figure (average balance) is calculated and averaged across all accounts with large transactions, including those with no PRIJEM/VYDAJ; only the first figure's average excludes such accounts

alternatives.interpretation: Both figures are calculated and averaged only for accounts that have at least one signed (PRIJEM or VYDAJ) transaction among their large transactions
